_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Thirty-five distinct adults named in 11 official NCA/CPS releases across ten UK drug cases. Each profile has a person-specific court outcome, historical UK drug-operation evidence and publication-date legal status. A case grouping does not imply pairwise collaboration. No precise or current position, arrest address, evasion route, photograph or inferred link is included. Older releases do not establish present custody or later appeals.
